theorem Artin_exercise_6_8_1_containment {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (a b : G) :
  ∀ H : Subgroup G,
    (a ∈ H ∧ b ∈ H) ↔
      (b * a * b ^ 2 ∈ H ∧ b * a * b ^ 3 ∈ H) := by
  intro H
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    refine ⟨H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hb ha) (H.pow_mem hb 2),
            H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hb ha) (H.pow_mem hb 3)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hb : b ∈ H := by
      have h_mul := H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem h1) h2
      have hid : (b * a * b ^ 2)⁻¹ * (b * a * b ^ 3) = b := by group
      rwa [hid] at h_mul
    have ha : a ∈ H := by
      have h_a := H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hb) h1) (H.inv_mem (H.pow_mem hb 2))
      have hid : b⁻¹ * (b * a * b ^ 2) * (b ^ 2)⁻¹ = a := by group
      rwa [hid] at h_a
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
